Meetily vs Notion AI: Frequently Asked Questions

children.q: What is Meetily and how is it different from Notion AI?
children.a: Meetily is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant that processes everything locally on your device. Unlike Notion AI which processes data in the cloud, Meetily ensures 100% privacy with no external data transmission. Key differences: 100% Local Processing (vs cloud-based), Free (vs $10/month), Open Source (vs proprietary), GDPR/HIPAA Compliant by Design (vs limited compliance).

children.q: Is Meetily really free compared to Notion AI's $10/month?
children.a: Yes, Meetily is free and open source (MIT license) for personal use with no subscription fees. Notion AI costs $10/month per user ($120/year). Over 5 years, individual users save $600 with Meetily. Organizations get custom pricing with dedicated support.

children.q: Which is better for privacy: Meetily or Notion AI?
children.a: Meetily is significantly better for privacy. All data processing happens locally on your device with no external transmission. Notion AI processes and stores all your data in the cloud. For GDPR, HIPAA, or privacy-sensitive use cases, Meetily provides complete data sovereignty while Notion AI requires trusting third-party cloud processing.

children.q: Can Meetily work with Notion for collaboration?
children.a: Yes, Meetily can export transcriptions that you can import into Notion for collaboration. Meetily handles the privacy-critical transcription locally, then you can share cleaned-up notes in Notion. This gives you best of both worlds: private transcription plus collaborative features.

children.q: Does Meetily work offline like Notion AI requires internet?
children.a: Yes, Meetily works completely offline since all processing happens locally. Notion AI requires constant internet connectivity as it sends data to cloud servers for processing. This makes Meetily ideal for secure environments or situations with limited connectivity.

children.q: Can I migrate my data from Notion AI to Meetily?
children.a: Yes, you can export your existing notes from Notion before switching. While formats may differ, you can reference historical data. Going forward, all new meetings will be processed locally with Meetily, giving you complete privacy and control.

children.q: Is Meetily suitable for teams already using Notion?
children.a: Yes, Meetily complements Notion perfectly. Use Meetily for private, local meeting transcription, then share curated summaries in Notion for team collaboration. This ensures sensitive meeting content stays private while maintaining team productivity.

children.q: How does cost compare over time?
children.a: Over 5 years: Meetily costs $0 (free), Notion AI costs $600 ($10/month x 60 months). Individual users save $600. For teams of 10 users, savings reach $6,000 over 5 years. Organizations get custom pricing - contact us for details.
